brief: Ocean Rd over the Maumee's mouth into the North Sea (East Coast). Modelled on the 1973 westbound Chesapeake Bay Bridge: a steel suspension main span of 488 m between two slender steel portal towers with cross-bracing, a stiffening deck truss under the deck, 57 m clearance, reached on steel deck-truss and girder approach spans on concrete piers, the whole painted grey. Here: a 420 m suspension span over the mouth, anchorages on the banks, girder approaches over the dunes and the basin. Foundations: caissons 30 m below the modelled bed under the towers, 25 m elsewhere; anchorages set deep in the headlands.
